turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
rfect match
• Trim the wick: While optional, trimming the wick to 1/4" before the first light gives an ultra-efficient burn.
menu
• Burn long enough: Let the tea light burn for at least 1.5 hours so the wax melts completely across the surface.
• Let it finish naturally: Towards the end of its life, let it burn until it goes out on its own to use up all the wax.
• Safety: Always burn on a flat, level surface and never leave a burning candle unattended.
